artifact_label: Independent synthetic evaluation drafted before project-candidate inspection

provenance.note: All requests, baseline prompts, review evidence, and negatives were drafted independently for this evaluation. No project candidate inspection informed this artifact.

evaluation_scope: Photorealistic adult interaction with an ordinarily intangible or architectural environmental surface that behaves as one continuous handleable layer
review_interpretation: The supported statuses assess explicit textual support in the independent baseline prompt before packing. They do not claim that any generated image has passed visual review.
dimension_policy: Subject, setting, event, and conceptual meaning are locked per case. Open dimensions are optional refinements only and cannot replace the manipulated environmental surface, change the actor's role, alter the core action, or remove required physical continuity and contact readability.

positive_cases.synthetic_request: Make a photorealistic image of an adult dockworker lifting the harbor water itself into a translucent curved flap beside the pier, with the flap still connected to the water below.
positive_cases.subject: One adult dockworker physically handling the harbor's water surface
positive_cases.setting: A broad harbor pier at dawn with moored boats
positive_cases.event: The dockworker lifts one continuous region of the water surface into a curved translucent sheet that remains attached to the harbor
positive_cases.conceptual_meaning: Literal physical handling of the water surface in an otherwise photographic harbor scene
priorities: Both hands visibly grip the same raised water region
The lifted water has a continuous, visible connection to the harbor
Curvature, refraction, and attachment ripples make the water's material response legible
The dockworker's crouch and reach look physically stable
open_dimensions: Dockworker's adult age, appearance, and clothing colors
Boat types and distant harbor details
Exact crop and lens within a side view that retains the full body, hand contacts, and connected boundary
Subtle dawn color palette and photographic grain
positive_cases.baseline_photographic_prompt: A full-body documentary photograph of an adult dockworker crouching on a broad harbor pier at dawn. Both boots remain flat on the dry deck, knees apart, with the torso centered above the feet. Their two visible forearms extend forward with comfortably bent elbows; each hand grips the same lifted ridge of the harbor's water surface, thumbs above and curled fingers beneath. The water rises as one translucent, flexible sheet, still joined continuously to the harbor along its broad lower boundary. Its curved thickness refracts moored boats, while small ripples gather at the attachment. A clear side angle separates every finger, wrist, and sheet edge; the lifted water casts a faint caustic on the pier.

literal_baseline_evidence: Their two visible forearms extend forward
each hand grips the same lifted ridge of the harbor's water surface
prepack_body_review.reason: The two forearms and gripping hands belong to the single dockworker, and both hands act on one identified water ridge.

literal_baseline_evidence: Their two visible forearms extend forward with comfortably bent elbows
prepack_body_review.reason: The contact is placed forward within a bent-elbow reach instead of requiring locked elbows, crossed arms, or a reach behind the torso.

literal_baseline_evidence: Both boots remain flat on the dry deck, knees apart, with the torso centered above the feet.
prepack_body_review.reason: Both feet provide grounded support on the pier and the centered torso makes the crouching lift plausible without leaning unsupported over the harbor.

literal_baseline_evidence: thumbs above and curled fingers beneath
still joined continuously to the harbor along its broad lower boundary
prepack_body_review.reason: Opposed thumb-and-finger contact locates each grip on opposite faces of the sheet, while the continuous lower attachment distinguishes a lifted water region from a detached object.

literal_baseline_evidence: A clear side angle separates every finger, wrist, and sheet edge
Its curved thickness refracts moored boats
prepack_body_review.reason: The requested angle separates the hand silhouettes from the manipulated edge, and refraction makes the sheet's curvature and depth visible in the projected image.

positive_cases.synthetic_request: Photograph an adult road worker rolling the existing asphalt road surface into a low curl with both palms. Keep the lane marking bending with the road and the curled strip unbroken from the pavement behind it.
positive_cases.subject: One adult road worker manipulating the actual asphalt road surface
positive_cases.setting: A street with a painted lane marking and intact surrounding pavement
positive_cases.event: The worker rolls a continuous strip of the existing road surface into a low curl with both palms
positive_cases.conceptual_meaning: An ordinary street surface becomes physically rollable while retaining its road identity
priorities: Both palms visibly bear against the same asphalt curl
The asphalt strip and lane marking remain continuous with the road
The underside, compressed grit, and cast shadow communicate thickness and bending
A supported kneeling posture and clear three-quarter view preserve body readability
open_dimensions: Worker's adult age, appearance, and workwear colors
Lane marking color and distant street architecture
Photographic focal length and framing margin while keeping the body supports and connection visible
Daylight warmth and asphalt aggregate color
positive_cases.baseline_photographic_prompt: A street-level photograph shows an adult road worker slowly rolling the actual asphalt surface into a low curl beside a painted lane marking. The worker kneels on both knees, shins resting on intact pavement, with their torso upright and centered above their knees. Both bare hands rest on the same broad curl, palms forward, fingers spread over its upper face, wrists straight and elbows softly bent. The asphalt remains one unbroken strip connected to the road behind the curl; the painted line bends with it. Compressed grit, a dark underside, and the curl's cast shadow make its thickness readable. An unobstructed three-quarter view shows both hands, both arms, both knees, and the continuous connection.

literal_baseline_evidence: an adult road worker
Both bare hands rest on the same broad curl
both hands, both arms
prepack_body_review.reason: The scene contains one worker, gives that worker two hands acting together on the same curl, and explicitly retains both arms so ownership can be followed.

literal_baseline_evidence: wrists straight and elbows softly bent
prepack_body_review.reason: Straight wrists and slightly flexed elbows establish a plausible forward palm contact without extreme wrist rotation or an overextended arm.

literal_baseline_evidence: The worker kneels on both knees, shins resting on intact pavement, with their torso upright and centered above their knees.
prepack_body_review.reason: Both knees and resting shins support the worker on undisturbed pavement, and the upright torso stays above this grounded support area.

literal_baseline_evidence: palms forward, fingers spread over its upper face
one unbroken strip connected to the road behind the curl
prepack_body_review.reason: The palms and spread fingers occupy the visible upper face rather than passing through the asphalt, and the unbroken strip specifies the continuous manipulated road region.

literal_baseline_evidence: An unobstructed three-quarter view shows both hands, both arms, both knees, and the continuous connection.
a dark underside, and the curl's cast shadow make its thickness readable
prepack_body_review.reason: The three-quarter view retains hands, limb paths, grounded supports, and the connection, while underside contrast and a cast shadow resolve the curl's depth.

positive_cases.synthetic_request: Create a realistic photograph of an adult gathering the edge of a building's shadow into a shallow pleat held at waist height. The shadow should behave like a thin matte layer that still joins the larger shadow on the plaza.
positive_cases.subject: One adult physically gathering a building's shadow
positive_cases.setting: A sunlit paved plaza crossed by a building's shadow
positive_cases.event: The adult pinches two nearby points on the same shadow edge and gathers it into a shallow suspended pleat at waist height
positive_cases.conceptual_meaning: A normally intangible shadow has a tactile, foldable presence while remaining connected to its environmental source region
priorities: Two visible fingertip pinches gather one shadow edge
The pleat remains continuously attached to the larger ground shadow
An air gap and self-shadow reveal a shallow fold with depth
The adult's stance, elbows, and hand placement remain physically readable
open_dimensions: Paving pattern and the building's architectural style
Exact sunny time of day within lighting that keeps the contact points and shadow boundary legible
Lens and framing margin within a full-body illuminated-side view
positive_cases.baseline_photographic_prompt: A candid full-body photograph of an adult on a sunlit plaza gathering the edge of a building's shadow into a shallow, suspended pleat. The person stands with both feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly flexed, and hips above the midpoint of their stance. Their relaxed shoulders and bent elbows bring both hands to waist height; thumbs and fingertips pinch two nearby points on the same dark edge. The gathered shadow behaves as a thin matte layer, connected without a break to the broad shadow lying across the paving. A narrow air gap and soft self-shadow beneath the pleat reveal its depth. Seen from the illuminated side, both arms, all contact points, and the attached boundary remain distinct.

literal_baseline_evidence: Their relaxed shoulders and bent elbows bring both hands to waist height
both arms, all contact points
prepack_body_review.reason: The single adult's shoulders, elbows, arms, and hands form an explicit limb chain to the two contact points.

literal_baseline_evidence: relaxed shoulders and bent elbows bring both hands to waist height
two nearby points on the same dark edge
prepack_body_review.reason: Waist-height contact with bent elbows and neighboring pinch points keeps both hands within a comfortable reach without forcing an overhead, crossed, or stretched pose.

literal_baseline_evidence: both feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly flexed, and hips above the midpoint of their stance
prepack_body_review.reason: A two-foot stance with the hips centered over it supports the upright gathering action and avoids an unsupported lateral lean.

literal_baseline_evidence: thumbs and fingertips pinch two nearby points on the same dark edge
connected without a break to the broad shadow lying across the paving
A narrow air gap
prepack_body_review.reason: The pinches identify specific edge contacts on one continuous shadow region, and the air gap separates the lifted pleat from the pavement rather than merging the hand and ground planes.

literal_baseline_evidence: Seen from the illuminated side, both arms, all contact points, and the attached boundary remain distinct.
soft self-shadow beneath the pleat reveal its depth
prepack_body_review.reason: The illuminated-side projection keeps the dark edge and hand contacts distinguishable, while self-shadow makes the otherwise dark pleat's depth readable.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Photograph an adult hauling a wet mooring rope onto a harbor pier as ordinary water splashes below.
negative_requests.reason: The handled object is a rope; the water only splashes.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Show an adult wringing a soaked tarpaulin on a dock beside calm harbor water.
negative_requests.reason: A separate manufactured tarpaulin is manipulated, not the harbor surface.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Photograph a roofer unrolling a purchased roll of roofing felt on the pavement.
negative_requests.reason: The roll is a discrete manufactured material lying on the road, not the existing road surface.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Show a mason lifting one loose, rigid paving slab out of a sidewalk repair site.
negative_requests.reason: Ordinary removal of a rigid construction unit does not deform the environmental surface into a continuous handleable layer.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Photograph an adult peeling an old paper concert poster from a brick wall.
negative_requests.reason: The pre-existing paper poster is peeled; the architectural wall is unchanged.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Show a utility worker using a hook to lift a round metal manhole cover from the street.
negative_requests.reason: This is normal handling of a rigid removable cover, not continuous road-sheet manipulation.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Photograph an adult making a rabbit hand shadow on a sunlit wall.
negative_requests.reason: The person changes the projected shadow by posing their hands; they do not physically touch or lift the shadow itself.

negative_requests.synthetic_request: Show an adult bending a reflective foil sheet that mirrors the blue sky and clouds.
negative_requests.reason: The handled layer is foil bearing a sky reflection, not the sky's environmental surface.
